newsitem.title: CHINA: Timetable for Tuesday funeral of China's Deng.
newsitem.headline: Timetable for Tuesday funeral of China's Deng.

text.p: The following is a timetable for the official memorial service on Tuesday for Chinese paramount leader Deng Xiaoping at the Great Hall of the People on Beijing's Tiananmen Square.
4.30 a.m. (2030 GMT) - Tiananmen Square opens after its nightly closure for cleaning
6:54 a.m. (2254 GMT) - Daily flag raising ceremony at Tiananmen Square, timed to coincide with sunrise.
7:30 a.m. (2330 GMT) - Martial law security provisions take effect in the square, barring unauthorised people from entering the area.

8.00 a.m. (0000 GMT) - Top leaders including President Jiang Zemin, Premier Li Peng join 10,000 official mourners filing into the main auditorium of the Great Hall of the People where Deng Xiaoping's ashes lie in state.
9:50 a.m. (0150 GMT) - China Central television to begin broadcasting memorial ceremony live on all eight channels
9.55 a.m. (0155 GMT) - Chinese state radio to begin broadcasting the ceremony live.
10:00 a.m. (0200 GMT) - Whistles and horns on trains, ships, warships and in factories across China will be blown for three minutes to mark nationwide mourning.

10:03 a.m. (0203 GMT) - Official start of the memorial ceremony, which will be broadcast live by radio and television around the world. Jiang, Deng's handpicked successor, is expected to deliver the eulogy.
11:00 a.m. (0300 GMT) (approximately) - Memorial service ends; leaders, family members and other mourners leave the Great Hall of the People, martial law provisions lifted at Tiananmen Square.
